name: liftoff/popover
title: Popover
description: Themed native popover built atop OriginPopover.

files.content:
---
/**
 * @title Popover
 * @level liftoff
 * @description Themed native popover built atop OriginPopover.
 * @category Overlays
 * @hydration optional
 * @accessibility
 * - Delegates native popover semantics and focus return to `OriginPopover`.
 * @keyboard
 * - Native light dismiss and Escape; trigger uses `popovertarget`.
 * @slots
 * - `default`: Popover content.
 */

import OriginPopover from "@lsui/origin/Popover.astro";
import type { ComponentProps } from "astro/types";
import "./core.css";

type Props = ComponentProps<typeof OriginPopover>;

---

<OriginPopover {...Astro.props}><slot /></OriginPopover>
